verdict.rationale: Flagright documents a transaction verify endpoint that takes the transaction payload for checking before it proceeds, with real-time transaction monitoring and rule instances that run checks on transactions. Alert and alert-hit endpoints suggest flagged items can be inspected afterwards. However, the evidence never shows the verify response returning a release decision (allow/block/suspend) or the specific rule or watchlist matches behind it; the closest example, rule execution results, is documented only for user lookups. Missing for 10: a documented decision field on the verify response, documented per-transaction rule-hit or match details tied to that decision, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the pre-release screening flow.
